run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with auto-cc to the gtest mailing list
run_main_with_cc: run the main function to invoke upload.py with a custom --cc flag appended to existing recipients
run_main_without_cc: run the main function to invoke upload.py with the gtest group auto-added as the cc recipient
review_main_cc_parsing: review the main function and how it parses and modifies the --cc command line flag
review_main_execv: review the main function and how it uses os.execv to replace the process with upload.py
